order: one-file files, one-file patches, three-file files, three-file patches; sequential, no retries
acceptance: Real production dispatch and worker produce a retained exact candidate. Actual sandboxed tests must pass; a different native QA must permit the exact candidate and actual receipt; the fixture receiver then calls production accept. Exact grading additionally compares all complete candidate bytes against the known fixture.
limitations: One observation per arm; descriptive results cannot establish statistical quality noninferiority, production reliability, cost savings or causal latency gains.
Only manually supplied fictional modules and fixed tests are shared with the existing host model. Synthetic company binding and grant are fixture data; no actual company state or authority changes.
Requested/applied model controls differ from effective provider settings; missing observations remain unknown.
All failed or uncertain calls stay retained and hold that case without retry. Source integration, installation and deployment are outside this evaluation.
